quality_claims: No hidden jury gold; structural citation/abstention scores are not independent usefulness scores.
concurrency_proof: Require overlapping Mozaik loops and simultaneous active slots from the local llama.cpp server; client HTTP overlap alone is insufficient.
mono_agent: One Mozaik agent performs all four same-budget tasks, with fresh task context; same retrieval and critic tools.
serial: Four distinct Mozaik role agents; research and industry tasks serialized.
parallel: Four distinct Mozaik role agents; research and industry genuinely concurrent, then writer and independent critic.
falsifiers: Any invented or misattributed citation accepted
No independent quality uplift: do not claim one
budget_meaning: Equal ceilings for model calls, input/output tokens and process CPU threads; measured actual tokens and CPU may differ and must be reported. Wall time is measured, not assumed improved.
